notes.corpora: agentdojo-upstream (and every AgentDojo-format corpus with run errors)
notes.text: Attack success rate convention for run errors. AgentDojo imposes outcomes on runs that end in a harness error (agentdojo.run_error_imposed_outcome@1; security = true). Counting them, as the AgentDojo results page does, reproduces its ASR for command-r-plus, gemini-1.5-pro-001, gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 and Llama-3-70b; the papers exclude them. Every ASR or utility statistic over AgentDojo-format corpora must state whether imposed run-error outcomes are counted, and report the count excluded.

Benchmark checker validity: AgentDojo #181 (banking injection tasks count any transfer to the attacker IBAN) and #161 (Mandate user_task_5 always true) bias the logged booleans. The logged values are kept; a statistic that uses them states the affected tasks and, where computed, the datum re-score (Mandate baseline II 75.0% vs 72.9%).

Pre-check sample rates are from a deterministic stratified sample (about 5 per stratum, 1 per stratum when strata exceed 300) and are not population estimates; compare population rates (L1 raw outcomes, OS-1) or post-stratified rates with paper numbers, never the raw sample proportion.
